in_marathi.name: Harpal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Grabber of wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harpal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Harpal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Harpa' which means 'grabber' or 'holder'. This name is often associated with wealth and prosperity. In Hindu mythology, Harpal is a divine name for Lord Vishnu, who is known as the preserver of wealth and the giver of boons. The name is believed to bring abundance and financial success.
